topic: Costrict Proxy: Account Quota to API Key for Agents

key_points: Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway for native Costrict accounts, built on CLIProxyAPI v7
Turns a single Costrict account quota into API keys usable by other agents/clients
Provides Costrict-specific auth, model catalog, request protocol, and management API
Windows x64 and Linux amd64 release packages with systemd install scripts
Runs on port 8317 by default; management page at /management.html
Serializes Costrict generation requests (one active at a time) with bounded FIFO queue (max 32, 30s wait), returns HTTP 429 + Retry-After on overflow
Auto-refreshes Costrict tokens when refresh token + login state present
Model catalog bound to account credentials fingerprint, stored at auth-dir/.costrict/model-catalog.json
Go 1.26+ required to build from source; created 2026-08-16, ~1 star
CoStrict CLI is an open-source AI agent forked from Google's Gemini CLI
Multi-provider support: Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, local models, and any OpenAI-compatible API
Custom LLM support via env vars (USE_CUSTOM_LLM, CUSTOM_LLM_API_KEY, CUSTOM_LLM_ENDPOINT, CUSTOM_LLM_MODEL_NAME)
Supports Chinese providers: Doubao, Qwen, Kimi, DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM
MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for custom integrations
Apache 2.0 licensed; config stored in ~/.costrict/settings.json
Auth options: Google OAuth, Gemini API key, Vertex AI, or custom LLM
CoStrict is Sangfor's (深信服) open-source enterprise AI coding solution for 'serious development'
Targets intranet development + high-quality-requirement scenarios; supports private deployment
Data stays inside the intranet — protects code/document assets from leakage
Test-driven development with auto bug-fix and auto test-case adjustment
CodeReview with multi-expert, multi-angle review
Auto-learns historical code and business knowledge to generate business-aligned code
Operational data: 2000 GitHub stars in 4 months; AI-generated code = 35%+ of total R&D code
Per-person daily code output rose from 70 to 360 lines/day with AI Agent model
Blocked 11,186 bugs in H1 2025 with 74% disposal rate, saving ~55 person-years, online issues down 43%
Infisical Agent Vault is an open-source HTTP credential proxy and vault for AI agents
Gives agents secure access to services without exposing real secrets to them
Addresses prompt-injection risk: agents are non-deterministic and easy to manipulate
Traditional secrets management (delivering secrets directly to workloads) fails for agents
Positioned as the right form factor for secrets management in the AI era
Microsoft Copilot agents also need endpoint URL/API construction for external calls
Shows the broader pattern of exposing agent capabilities via API endpoints
Enterprise platforms are standardizing on OpenAI-compatible proxy patterns for agents

Infisical processes billions of secrets per month and argues agents need a credential-proxy form factor, not direct secret delivery

angles: Costrict Proxy solves the 'one account, many agents' problem by converting a single Costrict subscription quota into reusable OpenAI-compatible API keys
Self-hosted gateway keeps credentials inside the intranet — aligns with CoStrict's enterprise data-security positioning
OpenAI-compatible surface means any existing agent/tool (OpenAI SDK, LangChain, etc.) can consume Costrict quota with zero code changes
Built-in management UI + quota diagnostics (readiness, quota, model catalog) make it easy to monitor account health
Serialized request queue with 429/Retry-After is a deliberate rate-limiting design to stay within account quota
Comparison to Infisical Agent Vault: both are credential proxies, but Costrict Proxy is quota-to-API-key focused while Agent Vault is secret-vault focused
Costrict Proxy is very new (created Aug 2026, ~1 star) — early-stage tool, so review should set expectations about maturity
